settings.title: AI settings

settings.autoSummaryDaily: Generates the daily report at {{time}} every day

settings.keyOllamaHint: Usually not needed for local Ollama models
settings.enabledHint: When off, the chat and summary pages show a disabled notice; settings are kept.
settings.autoSummaryDesc: Generates the daily report on schedule and backfills missing daily and last-week reports; requires a configured model.
